cost_model.kalshi_fee_formula: per contract per side = ceil(coeff*p*(1-p)*100)/100; round trip ~= 2 sides + half-spread
cost_model.notes: half-spread is measured per market from the live book (ask-bid)/2; the edge floor is fee+half-spread

framing: Agent-driven prediction-market forward CALIBRATION tracker. No bets, no real money, no account, no wallet. An LLM agent reads OPEN politics/policy/soft-news markets and commits its OWN probability q_agent (sha256+UTC) BEFORE resolution; p_market is recorded at the same instant. PRIMARY metric: is the agent's Brier score BETTER than the market's after N_min=50 resolved markets? Hypothetical bet-expectancy net of the fee/spread wall is a noisy secondary. Honest prior: roughly calibration-competitive but not decisively better; expectancy near zero by fees.

kill_switch.rule: after n>=N_min resolved markets, HALT if the agent's mean Brier is NOT significantly below the market's at one-sided 95%: mean(brier_market - brier_agent) - 1.645*se <= 0

primary_metric: calibration: agent Brier vs market Brier (paired, one-sided 95%)

rules.forward_only: market close/resolution date must be strictly in the future; the proposer is never run on a resolved market
rules.edge_floor: a hypothetical bet is logged only where |q_agent - p_market| > round_trip_cost(venue,p); otherwise side=abstain (frozen for calibration only)
rules.abstention: default; a no-edge or sub-cost read bets nothing but is still frozen for calibration
rules.settlement: official venue result only, strictly later than the freeze; PENDING until definite
